hyperedges.label: Structural safety controls (tier gate + scope + no-shell + blocklist)
Detection toolset gated by scope + tier model

nodes.label: Tamper-Evident Audit & Evidence
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Append-only hash-chained log of every decision/approval/invocation plus per-action evidence; GDPR-aligned retention; is both the safety mechanism and the legal defensibility record.

nodes.label: Authorization & Scope Engine
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Policy decision point: for each action checks verified + in-scope + active engagement window + permitted tier; resolve-by-IP + CIDR + hard denylist (RFC1918, cloud metadata). A deny stops everything downstream.

nodes.label: Core Data Model
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Entities: Operator, Asset, Engagement, Authorization, Approval, Action/Run, Finding, AuditRecord (hash-chained, referencing all others).

nodes.label: Engagement Manager
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Owns the lifecycle of an engagement: assets, verification status, time-box, enabled tiers, approvals, state. The system models engagements against verified assets, never free-text targets.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Isolated Runner
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Throwaway container per run, destroyed after; egress firewalled to the engagement's resolved in-scope IPs — the last line of defense if an upstream scope check is ever bypassed. Destructive sub-capabilities blocked, mirroring sqli_detect blocking --dump/--os-shell.

nodes.label: Exploit Tier
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Validated exploitation / credential testing / chained PoC gated by verified scope + per-action human approval + isolated runner + staging-preferred; off by default.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Approval
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Autonomy stops at the exploit boundary: a human approves each offensive action, producing a short-lived signed non-reusable token; keeps an LLM mistake bounded to a declined proposal rather than a fired exploit.

nodes.label: Kill Switch
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: A single operator action (plus automatic anomaly/limit-breach trigger) halts all runners for an engagement immediately.

nodes.label: MCP Server Orchestration (offensive)
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Evolution of the current detection server; exposes tools/playbooks to the agent but calls nothing until the authorization engine (and, for offensive tiers, the approval service) issues a token.

nodes.label: Authorized Offensive Security Engine
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Design-only blueprint to extend the detection-only server into a gated offensive platform; guiding principle is ethical hacking with structurally-enforced authorization (incapable of acting on unproven targets or running destructive actions without explicit human decision). Contains no exploit code.

nodes.label: Ownership Verification Service
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Authorization is proven, not asserted: DNS TXT challenge, HTTP .well-known file challenge, or counter-signed scope-of-work; mandatory, per-asset, time-boxed, re-checked. An unverified target is unreachable at any tier.

nodes.label: Phased Roadmap
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 verification+engagement core, 1 isolated execution, 2 human-approval gate, 3 exploit tier, 4 employee simulations; offensive capability only arrives after the entire governance scaffold exists.

nodes.label: Reporting Service (WeasyPrint HTML→PDF)
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Reuses the already-built HTML→PDF generator (WeasyPrint) for per-scan professional reports fed from the audit/evidence store.

nodes.label: Threat Model (abuse cases)
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Maps each abuse attempt (victim-domain targeting, re-targeting, coaxed autonomy, pivot/exfiltration, customer attack, log tampering, SSRF to metadata) to a specific mitigation.

nodes.label: Four-Tier Model (adds Exploit)
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: Extends Safe/Active/Intrusive with an Exploit tier; the Intrusive→Exploit jump is the critical boundary, adding mandatory human approval + isolated execution, off by default.

nodes.label: Defense-in-Depth Summary
nodes.author: Nikola Djurović
nodes.rationale: No single control is trusted alone: identity, authorization, scope, tiering, human gate, isolation, staging-first, audit, kill switch. The egress-locked runner backstops the authorization engine; human approval backstops the agent.

nodes.label: Publish Image Workflow
nodes.rationale: On v* tags, builds and pushes the Docker image to GHCR (semver + latest tags).

nodes.label: Destructive-Flag Blocklist
nodes.rationale: Hard blocklist stops destructive flags (sqlmap --dump, --os-shell) that would turn detection into an attack.

nodes.label: Three Ways to Run (Docker/Native/Local)
nodes.rationale: Docker all-in-one (Linux/macOS), native server + persistent Kali container (recommended on Windows since docker run -i stdio is unreliable there), or local Node with tools on PATH.

nodes.label: Kali Tool Host Container
nodes.rationale: Background vidence-kali container (ghcr.io image) holds the tools; first scan pulls it, later runs are instant.

nodes.label: Playbooks (MCP Prompts)
nodes.rationale: Methodology, not just tools: predefined OWASP/PTES-aligned playbooks chain tools and ask for a findings report, so you get an assessment rather than raw output. Defined in src/playbooks.ts.

nodes.label: Quick Start (npx)
nodes.rationale: Installs via npx and auto-pulls the Kali tool host on first run; Docker Desktop is the only prerequisite.

nodes.label: Safety Model (one paragraph)
nodes.rationale: Every call is tier-gated, scope-checked by resolved IP, built from structured params with no shell (no injection), and screened against the destructive-flag blocklist.

nodes.label: Scope Allowlist Guard
nodes.rationale: No tool runs against a host you did not authorize; enforced by resolved IP including CIDR ranges. It is a safety aid, not a grant of permission.

nodes.label: scope tool
nodes.rationale: Shows authorized scope + enabled tiers; recommended first call.

nodes.label: sqli_detect tool
nodes.rationale: intrusive tier: SQLi detection via sqlmap with data-extraction flags (--dump/--os-shell) blocked.

nodes.label: Three-Tier Safety Model
nodes.rationale: safe / active / intrusive tiers gate aggressive tools so each call is bounded to its permitted tier.

nodes.label: vidence-recon-mcp
nodes.rationale: A safe, batteries-included MCP server exposing curated security-testing tools and OWASP-aligned playbooks for authorized testing only; differentiated from thin LLM-runs-nmap wrappers by methodology, structural safety, and detection focus.

nodes.label: 0.1.0 Initial Release
nodes.rationale: Follows Keep a Changelog + Semantic Versioning; 0.1.0 (2026-10-08) shipped stdio MCP server, scope guard, three-tier model, 12 tools, 5 playbooks, Docker image, and CI.

nodes.label: Security Policy
nodes.rationale: Private reporting of issues in the server itself (scope-guard bypass, command injection, arg-screen bypass) are highest priority because they are the controls the whole project depends on; excludes third-party tool vulns and misuse.

nodes.label: Disclaimer & Acceptable Use
nodes.rationale: Authorized testing only; the user is solely responsible for authorization; scope allowlist is a safety aid, not permission; not a compliance-grade pentest; invoked tools are third-party software.

nodes.label: Graphify Project Instructions
nodes.rationale: Project keeps a knowledge graph in graphify-out/; use graphify query/path/explain before raw grep, and graphify update . after code changes.

nodes.label: content_fuzz tool
nodes.rationale: active tier: fuzzing via ffuf.

nodes.label: dir_bruteforce tool
nodes.rationale: active tier: path/file discovery via gobuster.

nodes.label: dns_enum tool
nodes.rationale: safe tier: DNS records via dig.

nodes.label: http_headers tool
nodes.rationale: safe tier: HTTP response headers via curl.

nodes.label: nikto_scan tool
nodes.rationale: active tier: web server known-issue scan.

nodes.label: nmap_scan tool
nodes.rationale: active tier: ports + service/version; SYN scans need NET_RAW/NET_ADMIN caps.

nodes.label: nuclei_scan tool
nodes.rationale: active tier: ProjectDiscovery Nuclei templates.

nodes.label: tls_scan tool
nodes.rationale: safe tier: TLS/SSL config + cert via sslscan.

nodes.label: whatweb tool
nodes.rationale: safe tier: web tech/stack fingerprinting.

nodes.label: wpscan tool
nodes.rationale: active tier: WordPress enumeration.

nodes.label: CI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: On push to main / PR, runs npm ci, lint, build, and test on Node 20 / ubuntu-latest.

nodes.label: Safety-Critical Files (scope.ts/exec.ts/safety.ts)
nodes.rationale: Changes touching the scope guard, exec wrapper, or safety model are load-bearing and require tests and a clear explanation; never weaken for convenience.

nodes.label: ToolSpec Declaration
nodes.rationale: Tools are declarative specs in src/tools/specs.ts: build args yourself from structured inputs (no free-form command strings), pick the right safety tier, and list destructive flags in blockedFlags; the server handles scope, tiering, timeouts, and arg screening uniformly.

nodes.label: Feature Request Template
nodes.rationale: Requires requester to confirm detection-orientation and declare safety tier + destructive flags to block.

nodes.label: Pull Request Template
nodes.rationale: Checklist enforces detection-orientation, correct safety tier + blockedFlags, tests+rationale for scope.ts/exec.ts/safety.ts changes, and passing lint/build/test.

nodes.label: Code of Conduct
nodes.rationale: Adapted from Contributor Covenant 2.1; unacceptable behavior explicitly includes sharing instructions/results aimed at attacking systems without authorization.

nodes.label: Detection Not Exploitation (ground rule)
nodes.rationale: Accepts recon/scanning/detection; rejects turnkey exploitation/post-exploitation, exfiltration flags, reverse shells, and third-party credential cracking.

nodes.label: Scope & Philosophy (detection not exploitation)
nodes.rationale: Covers recon/scanning/detection only; ships no turnkey exploitation or post-exploitation. That line keeps the project legal to publish, trustworthy to run, and community-welcome.
